execution_flows.name: Order Batch Submission, Pricing & In-Memory State Caching
execution_flows.trigger: HTTP POST /orders with JSON LegacyOrderPayload body
steps: 1. FastAPI deserializes JSON via LegacyOrderPayload (Pydantic v1 @validator strips customer_id; items remain untyped List[Dict[str, Any]]).

2. async def submit_orders() synchronously calls process_order_batch('batch-default', [{'items': payload.items, 'status': 'new'}], 'US', 'USD', False, False, '') while dropping customer_id and metadata.
3. process_order_batch() optionally parses override_yaml via unsafe yaml.load() (CWE-502), iterates orders, and appends regional hold tags onto mutable default list tags=[].

4. calculate_legacy_total() sums float item prices/quantities, checks /tmp/order_spool/fees.dat via _compute_handling_fee(), checks handlers.ACTIVE_PROMO_CODES (circular import), and applies 10% DEFAULT_TAX_RATE.

5. If notify_shell is True, executes subprocess.run(f'echo batch {batch_id} done', shell=True) (CWE-78), writes JSON summary into global ORDER_STATE_CACHE[batch_id], and returns {'accepted': accepted}.

execution_flows.name: Legacy Flask Health Endpoint & FastAPI Startup Hook
execution_flows.trigger: ASGI startup (@app.on_event('startup')) or WSGI HTTP GET /legacy/health
steps: 1. On FastAPI ASGI startup, deprecated @app.on_event('startup') runs init_cache() which prints 'Booting legacy FastAPI app' to stdout.
2. Separately, legacy_flask = Flask(__name__) defines GET /legacy/health returning jsonify({'ok': True}), though Dockerfile only boots Uvicorn against order_app.api.handlers:app.

execution_flows.name: CI/CD Pull Request Batch Synchronization Script
execution_flows.trigger: GitHub Actions pull_request_target (opened, synchronize) running bash scripts/legacy_sync.sh
steps: 1. .github/workflows/deploy.yml triggers on pull_request_target, checks out actions/checkout@main, and executes bash scripts/legacy_sync.sh.
2. legacy_sync.sh creates /var/tmp/order_batches/{incoming,processed,deadletter,reports} and configures stage concurrency.
3. run_retry_loop() invokes rotate_archives() to move *.csv files from incoming/ to processed/ and writes summary.txt metrics.

Function-signature mutable default list tags=[] on process_order_batch() in order_app/services/processor.py accumulating tags across requests.

Local filesystem batch spool /var/tmp/order_batches/{incoming,processed,deadletter,reports} mutated by scripts/legacy_sync.sh.
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Unsafe mixed async/sync execution: async def submit_orders() invokes synchronous CPU/filesystem work directly on the event loop, while unreferenced async def notify_partner_webhook() in order_app/infra/gateway.py calls blocking time.sleep(1) and synchronous requests.post() without a timeout. Error handling relies on anti-patterns: bare 'except:' around yaml.load() and 'except Exception: pass' around subprocess.run(shell=True) silently swallow failures, and global ORDER_STATE_CACHE plus mutable default tags=[] cause cross-request state corruption.
